- Added frosted backgrounds to the chat top bars, bottom action buttons, send restriction notices and input suggestions, so you can now see messages scrolling beneath them just like under the message input
- Changed how floating chat bars are spaced; they now keep an even 4 px gap, and the last message sits closer to the message input
- Changed how update controls are placed; they now sit on the main settings page right above About instead of at the top of Advanced settings
- Removed the Telegram Features entry from the main settings page; opening Telegram feature tips from Settings is no longer available
- Fixed an issue with the AI summary button animation that previously caused its arrows and stars to overlap and spill outside the button
- Fixed an issue with the shared media icons on profile pages that previously caused them to sit off-center
- Fixed an issue with the emoji panel category bar that previously caused a mismatched color strip with some themes
- Fixed an issue with the divider between the chat list and the chat in night themes that previously caused it to show as a black line

---

- 新增了聊天顶部提示栏、底部操作按钮、发送受限提示和输入联想面板的磨砂背景，现在可以像输入框一样透过它们看到下方滚动的消息
- 调整了聊天悬浮栏的间距，现在各栏之间保持 4 px 的均匀间隙，最后一条消息也更贴近输入框
- 调整了更新选项的位置，现在它们位于主设置页“关于”上方，不再放在高级设置顶部
- 移除了主设置页中的“Telegram 功能”入口，从设置页打开 Telegram 功能介绍不再可用
- 修复了关于 AI 摘要按钮动画的错误，该问题曾导致箭头和星星图案重叠并超出按钮范围
- 修复了关于个人资料页共享媒体图标的错误，该问题曾导致图标没有垂直居中
- 修复了关于表情面板分类栏的错误，该问题曾导致部分主题下出现颜色不一致的色条
- 修复了关于夜间主题中会话列表与聊天区域分隔线的错误，该问题曾导致分隔线显示为一条黑线
